summary.text: Adam Goldwyn is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 11 (Fargo) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Adam Goldwyn's service as "House since 2026". The member page lists Adam Goldwyn's committee assignments as including Judiciary Committee (interim).

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Adam Goldwyn's occupation as Professor of English, North Dakota State University.
It lists education as BA, Pomona College; MA, University College London; PhD, City University of New York.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Board Member, Temple Beth El, Fargo.
Adam Goldwyn is listed as married to Anastassiya with 1 daughter.
